filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("小红书收藏/笔记")
    - file.ext == "md"
views:
  - type: table
    name: 全部
    order:
      - file.name
      - author
      - collection
      - status
      - savedAt
    sort:
      - property: savedAt
        direction: DESC
  - type: table
    name: 按收藏夹
    groupBy:
      property: collection
      direction: ASC
    order:
      - file.name
      - author
      - collection
      - status
      - savedAt
    sort:
      - property: savedAt
        direction: DESC
  - type: table
    name: 未读
    filters:
      and:
        - note.status == "未读"
    order:
      - file.name
      - author
      - collection
      - status
      - savedAt
    sort:
      - property: savedAt
        direction: DESC
